page.content:
Creator economies, genres, and platform lore from vlogs to algorithmic fame.

How YouTube connects

  • Creator: Chad Hurley — Chad Hurley co-founded YouTube and served as its first CEO.
  • Character: Steve Chen — Steve Chen co-founded YouTube and built the early product.
  • Character: Jawed Karim — Jawed Karim co-founded YouTube and posted the first public video.
  • Faction: Google — Google acquired YouTube in 2006 and has owned the platform since.
  • Work: Me at the zoo — Me at the zoo is the first clip in YouTube's public archive.
  • Topic: YouTuber — YouTubers are the creators whose channels live on the platform.
  • Item: Google AdSense — AdSense supplied the first scalable ads against YouTube videos.
  • Topic: YouTube algorithm — The recommendation algorithm is how most viewers now find YouTube videos.
  • Creator: Susan Wojcicki — Susan Wojcicki was YouTube's CEO through the mature Partner era.
  • Location: YouTube San Bruno — YouTube's headquarters sat for years on the San Bruno campus.
  • Series: YouTube Rewind — YouTube produced Rewind as an official year-in-review video.
  • Work: YouTube Poop — YouTube Poop is a remix genre native to early YouTube.

What is YouTube?

YouTube launched in 2005 as a video-sharing site, was bought by Google in 2006, and became the default place to upload, monetize, and recommend moving images. Its lore is founders, AdSense money, the Partner Program, and the genres that grew up on the watch page.

Key threads lead to Chad Hurley, Steve Chen, Jawed Karim, Google, Me at the zoo and YouTuber.
